core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Medical Devices; Veterinary Medicines; Contract Manufacturing; Packaging Services; Export Services
specialty_focus: Kohlpharma is a leading German parallel importer of original pharmaceuticals, purchasing medicines in lower-priced EU markets and distributing them to pharmacies and wholesalers in Germany. It also provides contract manufacturing, packaging, and export services, handling a range of products including prescription and OTC drugs, cold-chain items, and medical devices. The company does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
